variables.headline: Static prompts are the ceiling of agent performance
variables.subheadline: Stop manually tuning your instructions. Build a system that evolves itself.

variables.title: Manual engineering doesn't scale
variables.body: Hardcoding logic for every edge case is a losing game. The agent must learn from its own failures.

variables.title: Step 1: The Execution Trace
variables.body: Log every reasoning step. Capture the raw input, the thought process, and the final output for every run.

variables.title: Step 2: The Critic Agent
variables.body: Deploy a separate model to audit the logs. Its only job is to find the gap between instruction and output.

variables.title: Step 3: The Optimizer Agent
variables.body: Feed the critique into a meta-prompt. The agent rewrites its own system instructions to solve the identified gap.

variables.title: Step 4: The Regression Guard
variables.body: Never ship an evolved prompt blindly. Test the new version against a golden dataset of previous successes.

variables.title: Architecture of Evolution
items: Log reasoning traces to find failures.
Audit logic with a dedicated Critic agent.
